$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-xwiki-source). Seeds the pre-built `xwiki` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister xWiki integration leaf (XwikiProvider SOURCE_ID='xwiki'). Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with a placeholder dev-stack location and auth:none so a fresh install resolves a base URL without pointing at an unintended host or carrying secrets. Operators set the real location/credentials and flip isEnabled via the OpenConnector Sources UI.

objects.name: xWiki
objects.description: xWiki knowledge-base REST API. Consumed by the OpenRegister xWiki integration leaf (article links + free-text page search). Dormant placeholder — set `location` to your xWiki REST base URL (e.g. https://wiki.example.org/xwiki), configure auth if required, and enable.
